rule.description: 当 if/elif 语句中包含三个或更多条件时，应将这些条件抽象为独立的函数，以提高代码可读性和可维护性。
checkpoints: if/elif 条件是否超过三个
是否可以将复杂条件抽取为语义清晰的函数
抽象后的函数是否有明确的命名

antipattern.context: If there are three or more conditions, you can abstract a function.

pattern.code:
def forward(self, positions, ...):
    model_config = vllm_config.model_config

    if hasattr(model_config.hf_text_config, "rope_parameters") and \
       "mrope_section" in model_config.hf_text_config.rope_parameters:
        cos = self.cos_sin_cache[positions].view(-1, -1)
    elif _should_apply_standard_rope(model_config, vllm_config):
        cos = self.cos_sin_cache[positions].view(-1, -1)
        sin = self.cos_sin_cache[positions].view(-1, -1)
    else:
        pass


def _should_apply_standard_rope(model_config, vllm_config):
    """判断是否使用标准 rope（将复杂条件抽象为函数）"""
    rope_params = getattr(model_config.hf_text_config, "rope_parameters", {})
    return "mrope_section" not in rope_params and not vllm_config.model_config.use_mla
